news.text: 🎙Teun #Koopmeiners on @SkySport:"We can do better, we know it and we told each other that in the locker room.The positive thing is that we never give up, but we can do better.#Spalletti said you need to leave me in peace?I wouldn't know...For me, there were no doubts that I would stay, I have always been focused on how I can help the team.I started well, but I always think about the team."[@PuebloJ]

🎙Francisco #Conceição on @DAZN_IT:THE MATCH"I think that over the 90 minutes we deserved to win, that's the truth.But #Milan's goal. What did they do more than us?Nothing.We hit the post, and also in the first half there was that chance I had.Fede's goal. We deserved the victory but we didn't achieve it.It's good not to lose, because we were about to lose in the last minute.We must continue on our path, the path is long."IMPROVED SHOTS"Football is like that, I am improving in that aspect.But these two posts I have hit this season, 10 centimeters to the right or to the left and everyone would have said that #Conceição is a goalscorer.This is football, I know it, I must improve to make those 5

🎙Federico Gatti on @DAZN_IT:SURPRISED TO SEE YOU AS A STRIKER"I'm sorry you are surprised, this is my past.They try in every possible way, but I never give up.I have a strength inside me which makes me never surrender, I go against everything and everyone.I went on the pitch with that rage."BRUSHING DUST OFF YOUR SHOULDERS"Of course, to tell you the truth, it's not like this goal brings a whole lot.It brings a point, it brings enthusiasm, but we have to do much more.If we want to aspire to something, we must win these matches"[@PuebloJ]

MORE HEART THAN GOALS#JUVE, THANKS TO #GATTIThe attack flops again: #Cisse gives #Milan false hope, then the header at the 92nd minute.After #Bremer against #Frosinone, another defender (who was supposed to leave) bails #Spalletti out. Before that, a post hit by #Conceição and sterile assaults. Again a bad #Kolo, #Ramos disappoints. #Woltemade debuts with grinta.[Front Page TuttoSport]

🎙Luciano Spalletti on @DAZN_IT:THE MATCH"An honest and correct analysis that you have made, I highlight that. We dominated the game.
